materials_scope: Existing materials array is the authored palette inventory, including potentially unused colors; material_count measures actual exported GLB materials.

description.en: Warm amber insect with a compact segmented body, broad paired wings and six simplified legs. Wing veins, soft tissue and posture are artistic approximations inspired by the fossil form, rather than a species-exact reconstruction.
description.zh: 暖琥珀色昆虫，具有紧凑分节躯干、宽阔成对翅翼和六条简化足。翅脉、软组织和姿态为化石形态启发的艺术近似，非物种精确复原。

scientific_scope.en: Evidence-informed stylized scene prop; formal production and physical-device acceptance remain unverified.
scientific_scope.zh: 基于事实参考的风格化场景道具；正式生产验收及实体设备验收仍未核实。
